notes: The programme's own DAAD page states no tuition fees, only the basic student union fee. TUM pages describe tuition for non-EU students at TUM generally (2,000 or 3,000 EUR per semester for Bachelor's, rising to 2,300/3,400 EUR from winter semester 2027/28), but these are institution-wide figures and the programme page says no tuition fees, so tuition is given as 0. The German A2 language requirement is listed here although the programme is taught in English, because the DAAD page states it as an admission requirement. No intake dates were extracted: the DAAD page gives application periods without a year (15 May to 15 July), which cannot be dated for an international applicant from the pages provided. The VPD certificate from uni-assist applies to applicants with an international university entrance qualification.
